scopeReason: context.ambition is "focused": every generation is a small, localised change

fanOut.rankingReason: It fixes the most genuinely broken thing — a stacked wave draining all three lives in a single collision pass — with a self-contained i-frame window plus visible blink feedback, and unlike Proposal 1 it uses its own timer fields rather than piggybacking on the shield state that the frozen shield tes

briefFeedback.gpt-6-astra: The young-child audience, one-change scope and named test entry points helped prioritize a concrete fairness problem over cosmetic changes. The conflicting required response formats add needless ambiguity; delete the duplicate format requirement. Include the frozen rules suite and presentation source as read-only context so proposals can check compatibility rather than infer it.
briefFeedback.gemini-3.8-flash: The specific guidance highlighting mobile/tablet play for young children (4-8 years old), touch target constraints, and headless test invariant names was very helpful and prevented breaking changes. The explicit reminder that pipeline checks monitor mid-game tap targets on 390×844 gave clear focus.
briefFeedback.grok-4.6: The audience rules (pre-readers, thumbs, no hard punishment) and the frozen harness names were the useful bits — they pointed at this collision rather than at HUD chrome. Two things got in the way: the tests are cited but not shown, so an unattended ship has to guess what `update()`+overlap asserts; and this prompt asks for PILLAR…ESCALATION and also for SUMMARY/EDIT as the only accepted structure. I would delete the empty gen-001 history, the “never gating” metrics (they still steer agents toward farming the autoplayer), and the duplicate response-format instructions.

proposalSummary: Add a 2s post-hit invincible window (`hitInvincibleMs` / `hitInvincibleUntil`) in `germ_fighter.html`. On a germ-player collision in `update()`, lose one life as today, then set `player.invincible = true` and `hitInvincibleUntil` immediately so later germs in that same filter pass (and for 2s after)
